body.name: local-query recovery handle \(\mathsf H_q\)
body.construction: Start from \(\mathsf H_q\): enumerate candidate disjoint \(K\)-row views; prune by exact observable unfolding ranks and induced local-minor vanishing patterns; recover only an unstructured \(q^K\)-label mixture by three-view decomposition; apply the component-equality pattern \(\mathcal E(P_X)\) to align those labels with \(K\) categorical coordinates; then reconstruct \(\pi\), the measurement tables, and latent conditional independences. Order branches by the number of unclassified observed rows and then the number of unresolved component pairs, using that lexicographic pair as the decreasing termination measure.
